observed_selection_limits: One broad history, two film-focused companion essays (Bhukha and Maya Miriga), four individual profiles and DAMaN.
Current selection gives substantial space to national/international recognition and directors/actors; workers, exhibition and popular music have less dedicated treatment.
Women have two dedicated profiles; this is not evidence that gender representation across the industry is adequate.
Several films have not been viewed in full during this research; synopsis-based analysis is explicitly labelled.
next: Assess each claim and the voice behind it; use the action register rather than treating this inventory as a completed fairness audit.

selection_rationale.chosen_scope: Eight introductory essays: one selective history, three film-centred articles and four individual profiles.
why_this_selection: Begun from the user’s interest in cinema history, national/international recognition and DAMaN.
Available primary award, festival, filmmaker and restoration sources supported bounded essays.
Existing KB links in literature, music and Nandita Das were reused.
biases_to_make_visible: Recognition archives overrepresent films and people with institutional visibility.
Director and actor profiles leave many kinds of labour less visible.
Access to online English sources is not a measure of historical or local importance.
selection_not_claimed: Representation of every district, language, community, gender or craft
selection_rationale.expansion_boundary: Six separately researched leads are future options; this pass does not silently expand the eight-article series.

baseline_notice: Historical pre-fairness source inventory; counts are not current after DAMaN additions.

coverage_dimensions.period: Selective historical arc1936to2024, with companion essays concentrated on post1970s work; not continuous decade-by-decade history.
coverage_dimensions.gender: Dedicated profiles include Parbati Ghose and Nandita Das; women’s producing/directing work appears, but this does not measure industry participation or establish representativeness.
coverage_dimensions.craft: Actors/directors dominate the fourprofiles; film music, literature, sound/editing/restoration receive selective discussion. Exhibition/distribution and broader technical labour remain gaps.
coverage_dimensions.source_access: Primary institutional records and published testimony carry most assertions; some historicalcatalogues were inspected only through indexedtext; English-online access influences selection.
coverage_dimensions.region_and_language: See paired regional audit matrix; film language, settings and maker connections must remain separate.
